updates.note: Management reaffirmed the plan to recruit 20,000 college graduates this year.
updates.quote: This year, we have a plan to recruit 20,000 college graduates.

updates.note: Revenue growth guidance for FY27 was revised down from 1.5%-3.5% to 1.5%-3%.
updates.quote: we are revising our revenue guidance to 1.5% to 3%.

updates.note: Operating margin guidance for FY27 is maintained at 20% to 22%.
updates.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains the same at 20% to 22%.

updates.note: Effective tax rate for the year is expected to be in the range of 29% to 30%.
updates.quote: We expect effective tax rate for the year to be in the range of 29% to 30%.

new_promises.statement: The plan is to have 6,000 frontier engineers over the next few years.
new_promises.quote: Our plan is to have 6,000 frontier engineers over the next few years.
new_promises.speaker: Salil Parekh
